answer: Every agent must post a slashable bond before its vote or attestation counts. A Sybil attacker pays one full bond per fake identity, and dishonest attestations destroy that bond, so the cost of an army grows linearly with its size while honest agents merely lock and recover capital. Access feels smooth as velvet to legitimate users, yet the guardrails are timber: rigid, load-bearing, and unforgiving. Under a karst of hidden aliases, every forged account is a sinkhole that swallows the attacker's own stake.
